summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CLEAR2WORK Personnel Entry Approval System - 3 new features: User Management, Pagination, and Automatic Alerts. All 22 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified all features working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features fully tested and working: 1) User Management with full CRUD at /users page, 2) Pagination for personnel (20 per page, 25 pages total) and entry logs, 3) Alerts section on dashboard showing 321 expiring documents. Backend has 22 pytest tests covering auth, user management, pagination, alerts, and dashboard stats.

details: GET /api/users - lists all users (excludes password)
POST /api/users - creates new user with validation
PUT /api/users/{id} - updates user (password optional)
DELETE /api/users/{id} - deletes user (prevents self-deletion)
Frontend /users page displays user list with edit/delete buttons
Add user form works with all fields
Edit form populates with existing data
Delete shows confirmation and success toast
GET /api/personnel?page=1&limit=20 returns paginated data with total, pages
Personnel list shows 20 items per page, 25 pages total (483 personnel)
Pagination controls (Önceki/Sonraki) work correctly
GET /api/entry/logs/paginated returns paginated entry logs
Entry logs pagination controls appear when needed
GET /api/alerts/expiring-documents returns expiring documents
Dashboard shows alerts section with 321 expiring documents
Alerts sorted by urgency (most urgent first)
Each alert shows personnel name, company, and expiring documents
Custom days parameter works (default 30 days)
Users menu item (KULLANICILAR) visible in admin navigation
All navigation items present: dashboard, personnel, entry-check, entry-logs, users, settings
